findings.title: Malformed journal search response is rendered as a list of blank entries
findings.expected: An error saying the journal could not be loaded, with no fake entries
findings.actual: Shows '14 entries match' and 14 cards that contain only '–' (no plant, date or text), with no error

findings.title: Non-list journal response is shown as 'No entries match'
findings.expected: An error, not an empty result
findings.actual: When the API returns an object instead of a list, the page shows '0 entries match' / 'No entries match' with no error

findings.title: Journal search stays on 'Loading entries…' forever when the request hangs, while showing stale results
findings.expected: A timeout with an error and a way to retry
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still says 'Loading entries…' under the results of the previous search, with no error or timeout
